decision_rules.equivalence: C01 must be retained as mathematically equivalent to C00, not counted as a new theory
decision_rules.gauge: A potential-column law cannot advance without an observable physical reference for the additive zero
decision_rules.energy: A same-sign cumulative loss law cannot advance as conservative without a field/medium energy-momentum sink
decision_rules.chromatic: A nu^-2 signal is presumptively plasma/medium until it clears multi-frequency plasma controls
decision_rules.reciprocity: Same-sign forward and reverse accumulation predicts a round-trip residual and photon-number/distance-duality consequences
decision_rules.metric_memory: C08 advances only if one causal field equation generates psi, the metric response, photon propagation, and stress-energy accounting
decision_rules.publication: A methods/theory note is eligible now only for the closure taxonomy and identifiability result; an empirical gravity claim requires the frozen real-data tests
